name: Product As Media Mapper
description: Identify product, app, commerce, service, packaging, data, and owned-channel surfaces that can become campaign media.

operational.approval_boundary: Safe for planning; require product, engineering, legal, and operations approval before altering product or customer-service surfaces.
operational.use_when: Use when a campaign should use owned product or service surfaces as the campaign platform.

limitations: Instruction package only; it does not provide or authorize an executable runtime capability.
usability.quickstart: Read SKILL.md and follow the documented workflow.
